pages.document: Undated Manchester College of Science and Technology statement, referring to early 1956
facts: Describes brittle altered metal and decision to cut in 1955
Institutional statement expresses belief that no character became unrecognisable through the process
pages.limits: General institutional claim; no per-cut inspection, frame or character-loss measurements

pages.document: Wright Baker minute to Registrar, dated 6 September 1955; filed stamp 10 October 1955
facts: Reports meeting with Bowden, Baker, Lankaster Harding, Fish and Allegro
Says Baker demonstrated proposed treatment on an actual piece of scroll
One scroll was at the College and Baker had authority to proceed
Requests temporary assistant for initially two or three months; assistant described as Baker's niece
pages.limits: Margin's handwritten name not securely transcribed; no cutting plan or target image

pages.document: G. Lankester Harding to B. V. Bowden, 12 October 1955; received 17 October
facts: Confirms arrangements concerning precautions, responsibility for damage, publicity, access and assistant payment
Reports receiving an Allegro letter on progress
pages.limits: Administrative terms; no measured damage or enclosure in this leaf

pages.document: Wright Baker to Harding, 19 October 1955, reference 15879/55
facts: Says first scroll was opened and roughly cleaned in four and a half days after equipment assembly
Says detailed cleaning took roughly as long again and an assistant was continuing it
Hoped within two days to complete a compound photograph showing the interior and all lettering
Reports many photographs taken during opening stages
Discusses assembly of pictures and mounting of sections for an exhibit
Requests second scroll soon while equipment, room and assistant remained available; estimates about ten days and anticipates tighter convolutions/corrosion bonds
pages.limits: Compound photograph is prospective on this date; no frame identifiers, pre-cut status or cut 21/22 assignment

facts: Professor of Mechanical Engineering sign-off and HWB/MES initials
pages.limits: No photographic attachment on this continuation

pages.document: Wright Baker copy to J. Waldron, Rathbone Books, 6 March 1956, reference 3709/56
facts: Describes spindle support, adhesive coating to prevent fragmentation, and strips generally extending about half a circumference
Describes saw as one and a quarter inch in diameter and 0.006 inch wide
Reports excellent lettering except some corrosion-damaged places
Explicitly lists enclosure: Photograph of cutting
pages.limits: The listed photograph is absent from this supplied PDF; nominal tool width is not a measured kerf or target-letter damage width
